meta.title: White label agency partner for Switzerland | Renee
meta.description: White label partner for Swiss agencies: design, web, 3D, content, ads. NDA, no client contact, 48–72 h, {{price.agencyHour}}. First job up to 4 h free.

h1: White label partner for Swiss agencies: more capacity, under your name.
lead: We take on production work for Swiss agencies of 1 to 30 people. You keep the client relationship; we deliver in your branding and in your tools.

deliver.title: Everything that can be produced remotely.

items.d: Presentations, campaign assets, layouts, final artwork.
Logos, brand systems and guidelines based on your concept.
Design and development, multilingual and SEO-ready.
Posts, Reels and carousels based on your content calendar.
Product visualisation and animation from CAD or references.
Set-up and management of Google and Meta campaigns.
Technical implementation, content and AI visibility.

steps.d: In your templates and tools, with one dedicated point of contact.
Correction rounds are defined in the scope. The files are yours.

rules.title: What you can expect from us.
items: No direct contact with your clients. Our name appears nowhere.
We work in your tools: Figma, Asana or Trello, Slack or Teams.
One dedicated point of contact, available during Swiss office hours.
Data processing agreement with standard contractual clauses whenever personal data is involved.

models.d: For individual tasks with no commitment.
Reserved hours per month. Details on the pricing page.
A set price per render, layout or landing page.

pilot.title: Test job: we deliver a first task of up to 4 hours free of charge.
pilot.text: So you can assess quality and collaboration without risk.
items: No obligation, no follow-up order required
NDA for the test job too
Delivery within {{stat.pilot}} hours of a complete briefing

items.q: Will our clients find out about you?
items.a: No. We stay out of sight, and the NDA sets this out in writing. Files and metadata are delivered unbranded.
Once paid for, all rights to the delivered work pass to your agency.

items.q: What happens if we hit a bottleneck at the weekend?
items.a: Our standard is Mon–Fri. Urgent weekend work is agreed in advance.
